subject.title: Exploring a chat-first Android surface for OpenClaw (discussion + possible focused upstreaming)

question: Should the official Android app move toward a chat-first default or mode, accept only focused UX/media slices while keeping the companion-node Overview flow, or leave chat-first forks outside core for now?
rationale: Current main partially improves Android chat access, but changing launch defaults or broader media/connectivity behavior affects onboarding, Gateway pairing, permissions, security posture, and release scope.

options.title: Scope Focused Android Slices
options.body: Keep this issue open while Android owners define narrow launch/navigation, media playback, and connectivity PR slices with real-device proof.

options.title: Keep Companion-First Android
options.body: Document that the official Android app remains a Gateway companion surface and ask fork authors to file only specific defects or narrow UX improvements.

options.title: Sponsor Chat-First Mode
options.body: Explicitly approve a chat-first default or mode and require upgrade, onboarding, media-permission, and real-device proof before merge.

recommendation.title: Scope Focused Android Slices
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while Android owners define narrow launch/navigation, media playback, and connectivity PR slices with real-device proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is centered on the official Android app surface, which CONTRIBUTING.md routes to obviyus.
